title: StateDB UI Improvement
body:
Contrast between LGB mode and Closed Loop mode is too low in dark theme (difficult to see the difference between the 2 different greens). The constrast looks better in Light theme but it's possible it's just optical illusion...
A dotted line in front of a dark background looks darker than the same plain color and looks lighter in front of a light background, so I think we should switch the 2 green colors in Dark mode (Darker for LGS mode and Lighter for closed loop).

Having LGS green color lighter than Closed loop mode is fine in light theme

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c556f86c-7093-4d6f-996e-aa81873b2f03)

comments.body: Proposal to remove the green bar when closed loop is enabled (most of the time) is better...
